title: Apple holds talks with Intel, Samsung for US chipmaking, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，苹果与英特尔、三星就美国芯片制造事宜进行了谈判
summary: Apple has held exploratory discussions about using Intel and Samsung Electronics to produce ‌the main processors for its devices, Bloomberg ‌News reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the deliberations.
summary_zh: 据彭博社周一援引知情人士的话报道，苹果已经就使用英特尔和三星电子为其设备生产主处理器进行了探索性讨论。

title: Apple Plans to Let Users Build Their Own Passes in iOS 27 Wallet App
title_zh: 苹果计划让用户在 iOS 27 钱包应用程序中构建自己的通证

title: Shares slide, oil prices elevated as US-Iran truce prospects dim
title_zh: 美伊休战前景黯淡，股价下跌，油价上涨
summary: By Rae Wee SINGAPORE, May 5 (Reuters) - Stocks in Asia slid on Tuesday while oil prices eased but remained well above $100 a barrel, as the U.S. and Iran continue to work towards a truce while at the
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 5 月 5 日 - 亚洲股市周二下跌，油价回落，但仍远高于每桶 100 美元，因美国和伊朗继续努力实现休战。

title: AI’s Hottest Private Companies Have Booming Crypto Shadow Market
title_zh: 人工智能最热门的私营公司拥有蓬勃发展的加密货币影子市场
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The race to sell retail investors a piece of the AI boom has gone mainstream — closed-end funds, interval funds, special-purpose vehicles.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——向散户投资者出售人工智能热潮的一部分的竞赛已经成为主流——封闭式基金、区间基金、特殊用途工具。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow futures trade flat with investors holding for Iran war developments
title_zh: 今日股市：标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数、道指期货持平，投资者持有伊朗战争进展
summary: Major gauges traded close to flat as investors adjusted to news that ships in the Strait of Hormuz had been struck with missiles.
summary_zh: 随着投资者根据霍尔木兹海峡船只遭到导弹袭击的消息进行调整，主要股指接近持平。

title: Meta picks Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan for El Paso data center financing, source says
title_zh: 消息人士称，Meta 选择摩根士丹利和摩根大通为埃尔帕索数据中心融资
summary: Meta Platforms is working with Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan Chase on ‌a roughly $13 billion financing package for a ‌data center in El Paso, Texas, a source familiar with ​the matter told Reuters on Monday.
summary_zh: 一位知情人士周一告诉路透社，Meta Platforms 正在与摩根士丹利和摩根大通合作，为德克萨斯州埃尔帕索的数据中心提供约 130 亿美元的融资方案。

title: S&P 500 falls from record high on Middle East worries
title_zh: 中东担忧令标普 500 指数从历史高位回落
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended lower after a South Korean ship was hit by an explosion in the Strait of Hormuz.The Dow fell more than one percent, the S&P 500 dropped four tenths of one percent after hitting a record high Friday and the Nasdaq slid about two tenths.
summary_zh: 故事：一艘韩国船只在霍尔木兹海峡发生爆炸后，美国股市收低。道琼斯指数下跌逾百分之一，标准普尔 500 指数在周五创下历史新高后下跌十分之四百分之一，纳斯达克指数下跌约十分之二。

title: 'Nobody's doing AI better than Palantir': Earnings takeaways
title_zh: “没有人比 Palantir 做得更好”：盈利要点
summary: Palantir (PLTR) beat first quarter estimates, posting adjusted earnings of $0.33 per share (vs. expectations of $0.28) and revenue of $1.63 billion (vs. expectations of $1.54 billion). Futurum chief market strategist Shay Boloor joins Yahoo Finance to discuss the results.
summary_zh: Palantir (PLTR) 第一季​​度超出预期，公布调整后每股收益 0.33 美元（预期为 0.28 美元），营收为 16.3 亿美元（预期为 15.4 亿美元）。 Futurum 首席市场策略师 Shay Boloor 与雅虎财经一起讨论了这一结果。

title: White House Weighs AI Working Group, Model Testing, NYT Reports
title_zh: 白宫权衡人工智能工作组、模型测试、纽约时报报道
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The Trump administration is considering an executive order to create a working group on artificial intelligence, according to the New York Times, among a series of steps to boost oversight of the emerging technology.Most Read from BloombergChina’s Unprecedented ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据《纽约时报》报道，特朗普政府正在考虑发布一项行政命令，成立人工智能工作组，这是加强对新兴技术监管的一系列措施之一。
